name: 31326 · Rincon, GA
findings: ZIP 31326 (Rincon) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 31326 (Rincon) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 31326 (Rincon) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
